label: Tiling of the cosmos by basic objects: The basic objects’ fusion is the cosmos and distinct basics…
term: tiling of the cosmos by basic objects
definition: The basic objects’ fusion is the cosmos and distinct basics share no common part. Schaffer’s subsequent argument uses only the weaker restriction that distinct basics are not related by parthood. Completeness, free recombinability and minimal completeness are proposed justifications, not definitions of parthood.
